data.name: Amru
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-M-R', meaning 'to command'. In Islamic tradition, Amru is a name given to a man of power, authority, and leadership.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the inner strength and courage of a person, often used for boys.

in_arabic.name: عمرو
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم عمرو مصدر من الفعل عمّر الذي يعني الحياة الطويلة والبقاء، ويُستخدم في التراث الإسلامي لتحديد العمر والمدة، وله أهمية في التاريخ الإسلامي حيث كان اسمًا شائعًا للصحابة والشخصيات الهامة

in_urdu.name: عمرو
in_urdu.long_meaning: عمرو کا نام عربی gốc سے لیا گیا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے لمبی زندگی اور بقا، اور یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے جہاں مسلمانوں کی اکثریت ہے

in_hindi.name: अम्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: अम्र नाम का अर्थ है लंबी आयु और जीवनकाल، और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है जहां इसका महत्व और प्रयोग देखा जा सकता है

in_pashto.name: عمرو
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عمرو نوم د عربی ریښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د اوږد ژوند او پاتې کېدو په معنا دی، او دا نوم په افغانستان او پښتونخوا کې هم استعمال کیږي چېرې چې د مسلمانانو اکثریت شتون لري

in_english.name: Amru
in_english.long_meaning: Amru name is derived from Arabic roots meaning long life and permanence, and it has historical significance in Islamic tradition as a name given to companions and important figures, symbolizing a long and prosperous life

data.cultural_impact: In various Islamic contexts, the name Amru beautifully encapsulates the notion of power, leadership, and authority. The name is often given to individuals who wield significant influence in society, be it in government, business, education, or in the religious sphere. This cultural association adds a sense of value and esteem to those who bear the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Amru holds deep spiritual meaning in Islamic culture as it symbolizes One's sacred duty and responsibility towards society and towards God. As a leader, a man named Amru is expected to make wise decisions, bringing justice, fairness, and peace to all. The name serves as a reminder of the immense power bestowed upon an individual, and the accompanying duty to use it for the greater good. Through the name Amru, Muslims are constantly reminded to seek God's guidance in their leadership roles and to strive for excellence in serving and inspiring their communities.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Amru ibn Al-Aas was a prominent Sassanid-Arab general during the early Islamic conquests. The name Amru carried significant weight in that era.
